summary: Frontend-only verification of 5 SoD Command Center add-ons (Voice Preview, Weekly Recap config, Share Briefing, Thread Rename, History Resume). All wiring confirmed present and functional in /app/sod. No uncaught runtime errors; only cosmetic Radix DialogContent aria warnings (ignorable per request).
verified_flows: Login admin + navigate /app/sod renders cleanly (no page errors)
Voice Preview: change voice-name -> Nova triggered GET /api/sap/digest/voice/sample?voice=nova -> 200 audio/mpeg, no error toast, autoplay attempted
Recap Config: recap-toggle unchecked->checked reveals recap-day; picked Wednesdays; digest-save -> PUT /api/sap/digest/config 200; after reload recap-toggle data-state=checked (persisted)

Share Briefing: digest-share-briefing prompt accepted default recipient; POST /api/sap/digest/share-briefing 200; toast 'Briefing emailed to 1 recipient(s)' with 'Audio .mp3 attached · live snapshot link included' description shown

Thread Rename: digest-ask-open -> digest-ask-history-toggle showed history list with rename buttons; digest-ask-rename-0 opened window.prompt; POST /api/sap/digest/ask/rename 200; history reloaded (GET ask/history 200)

History Resume: digest-ask-history-0 -> GET ask/thread 200 loaded messages into digest-ask-messages; follow-up via digest-ask-input+digest-ask-send -> POST ask 200 appended AI reply (message children grew to 6)
critical_code_review_comments: SodCommandCenter.jsx is >1000 lines — consider splitting Voice/Recap/Share/Ask blocks into subcomponents for maintainability (non-blocking)
DialogContent inside Ask modal is missing aria-describedby (cosmetic, but noted in Radix a11y warnings)
seed_data_creation: One new read-only share link created via Share Briefing test. One Q&A thread renamed. Recap config toggled ON with recap_day=wed (persists in digest config).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 new add-ons wired and functioning end-to-end on /app/sod. Recap config now persists with recap_enabled=true, recap_day='wed' in the demo org — if the daily cron is triggered on a Wednesday it will fire the weekly recap. Radix Select interactions confirmed with 200-400ms wait + get_by_role('option', name=...) click.
